settings.heading: A more personal way to shop Sufias.
settings.intro: Book a private appointment with Sufias Fashion for styling, private shopping, or help choosing the right pieces for your occasion.
settings.details_text: Tell us what you are looking for, choose your preferred date and time, and send your request. We’ll review it and contact you to confirm availability.
settings.card_one_text: Get help selecting silhouettes, colours and pieces that suit your occasion and preferences.
settings.card_two_text: Enjoy focused time to explore Sufias pieces with a more personal shopping experience.
settings.card_three_text: Need help before placing an order? Share your questions and we’ll guide you through the details.
